title: Volt / Concept Spec Scan
premise: An e-bike is scanned into a hologram; target boxes lock onto the battery, motor and brakes, and each spec rolls into place.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Original fictional Volt e-bike, stylized procedural wireframe; 360 Wh, 250 W and 180 mm are explicitly labelled CONCEPT design targets, not measured production specs. FACTS.md discloses this.
